summary: iter18 — Parent login share/reset + add-student bug-fix validation. BACKEND: 14/14 new pytest cases PASS in test_parent_login_share.py (4.95s); 13/13 regression iter17 cases PASS. Verified: (1) POST /api/students accepts payload with parent.email='', dob='', roll_number='', whatsapp='' — pydantic _blank_to_none validators coerce to None, no more 422. (2) Synthetic parent email uses '.school' TLD (parent.<uid_lower>@<schoolprefix>.school) and passes EmailStr at login. (3) parent_login dict returned ONLY: {email, is_new_account, default_password} — is_new_account=true returns 'Parent@123'; reusing existing parent.email → is_new_account=false AND default_password=null. (6) Parent end-to-end: created via blank-email flow → login with returned creds → GET /api/students returns only their child. (7) Seeded parent.stu-00001@sunrise.edu/Parent@123 regression unchanged. Teacher view (Priya): 20 buttons rendered, modal opens correctly with full RBAC parity.
critical_code_review_comments: models.py:7-15 _blank_to_none correctly handles None + whitespace-only strings; applied via field_validator(mode='before') on ParentInfo.email/whatsapp and StudentCreate.roll_number/gender/dob/admission_date/medical_notes/emergency_contact — covers all form-default fields that frontend may send as ''.

students.py:110 synthetic email format `parent.{uid.lower()}@{school_id[:6]}.school` is deterministic + collision-resistant within a school (UID is unique). '.school' is a valid IANA TLD so EmailStr accepts it. Lowercased on line 111 → idempotent dedup against db.users.

students.py:174 parent_login dict shape exactly matches spec: {email, is_new_account, default_password} — default_password=null when parent_is_new=false (line 172 ternary). Frontend ParentCredsModal correctly gates `if (pl && pl.is_new_account && pl.default_password)` on line 207 → modal does NOT appear when reusing existing parent.

students.py:177-210 GET /parent-login — teacher visibility uses _teacher_class_filter intersection (class_teacher_map ∪ timetable); IMPORTANT: Priya has Grade 6 A timetable slots so her access is wider than 'just Grade 5 A'. Test had to use (Grade 6 B) for true negative — flag for problem-statement clarity but RBAC implementation is CORRECT (timetable presence implies visibility, which matches business intent).

students.py:213-249 POST /parent-reset-password — writes password_reset_to_default_at audit field + log_action. Returns plaintext default ONCE in response only (never persisted). 404 if parent doc missing in master users.
